And from his speech (peace be upon him) to the Kharijites also

key_terms.إِمَام عَلِي: Imam Ali, the fourth Rashidun Caliph and first Shia Imam
key_terms.خَوَارِج: Kharijites, an early Islamic sect known for their literalist interpretation and rebellion against Ali ibn Abi Talib

ai.seo_question: What is the context of Imam Ali's speech to the Kharijites in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading introduces Imam Ali’s (AS) direct address to the Kharijites, a faction that emerged after the Battle of Siffin, characterized by their rigid literalism and rebellion against legitimate authority. It sets the stage for a detailed theological and political refutation of their deviations, highlighting the Imam's method of clarifying truth amidst early Islamic civil strife.
